method: Every listed raw frame personally inspected; individual SHA-256 retained after raw cleanup. Contact sheets only for presentation, no pixel manipulation.
observation: Personally inspected all24 fresh low/high street frames. Late-afternoon warm light and damage cues remain visible; wide views show multiple rising grey smoke columns. Literal every-frame minimum fails: actual moving route low x−40 at zoom0.5 contains no distinct complete smoke column, and close static commerce/oak views also miss two. Columns recorded in VFX world state are not proof of visible columns. No target relaxed.
